## 54099d17f2dd

**Concrete undeclared ordinary-sampler shortcut; audited source left unchanged.**
Generator SHA-256
`5b0ab830dbd12979b22091dc84c111b81d5b40570d8278652d979474c00b8593`,
version `3.0.0`, rule hash `4a6409bfdf9a`.

A plausible feature-conditioned rival is: **copy every normalized source cell
only when the template has five cells and the marker is left of the source;
otherwise copy only the first four normalized cells**. It fits all 3/3 canonical
pairs because every canonical source has four cells. It also matched the intended
rule on 288/288 ordinary draws (239 unique inputs) across difficulties
`easy/medium/hard`, seeds `{0,17,20261020}`, and sample indices `0..31`.
This is structural, not a lucky sample: the four ordinary profiles correlate all
five-cell shapes with leftward markers and all rightward markers with 3/4-cell
shapes.

The generator's lawful override domain supplies an exact disagreement. At
`seed=5409901`, `sample_index=1`, `difficulty="easy"`,
`template_shape="zigzag5"`, profile `right_tetromino`, the returned 8×12 grid
has relation `upper_right`, passes `self_check`, and contains five template
cells. The intended output includes color 8 at zero-based cell `(6,9)`; the rival
omits it. Public Racket application returned the retained intended output,
reported a valid output, matched catalog rule hash `4a6409bfdf9a`, and differed
from the rival. Thus the counterexample belongs to the documented generator
domain, but ordinary no-override lessons never emit its shape/relation
combination.

The selected portable task suite passed 149/149 tests, so this finding is outside
its declared rival set rather than a failure of the existing checks.

Evidence:

- `checks/audit/54099d17f2dd/probe.json`
- `checks/audit/54099d17f2dd/probe.py`
- `checks/audit/54099d17f2dd/input.json`
- `checks/audit/54099d17f2dd/racket.json`
- `checks/audit/54099d17f2dd/racket.log`
- `checks/audit/54099d17f2dd-task-tests/`
- `checks/audit/54099d17f2dd-task-tests.log`

Recommended follow-up: decouple five-cell template cardinality/asymmetry from
left/right relation in ordinary production, or explicitly narrow the claimed
production domain. No audited source was edited.
